question.de: Finde Jewel Changi Airport im äußersten Osten Singapurs.
question.hu: Keresd meg a Jewel Changi repülőteret Szingapúr legkeletibb részén.
question.ro: Găsește Jewel Changi Airport în extremitatea estică a Singaporelui.
question.en: Find Jewel Changi Airport in the far east of Singapore.

question.de: Finde den Merlion Park an der Marina Bay.
question.hu: Keresd meg a Merlion Parkot a Marina-öbölnél.
question.ro: Găsește Merlion Park la Marina Bay.
question.en: Find Merlion Park on Marina Bay.

question.de: Finde den Bukit Timah Hill im zentral-westlichen Teil der Hauptinsel.
question.hu: Keresd meg a Bukit Timah-hegyet a fősziget középső-nyugati részén.
question.ro: Găsește dealul Bukit Timah în partea central-vestică a insulei principale.
question.en: Find Bukit Timah Hill in the central-western part of the main island.

question.de: Finde das Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve im Nordwesten.
question.hu: Keresd meg a Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve-et északnyugaton.
question.ro: Găsește rezervația Sungei Buloh Wetland în nord-vest.
question.en: Find Sungei Buloh Wetland Reserve in the north-west.

question.de: Finde den Jurong Island Petrochemical Hub im Südwesten Singapurs.
question.hu: Keresd meg a Jurong Island Petrochemical Hubot Szingapúr délnyugati részén.
question.ro: Găsește Jurong Island Petrochemical Hub în sud-vestul Singaporelui.
question.en: Find the Jurong Island Petrochemical Hub in south-western Singapore.

question.de: Klicke auf die Region South West.
